name: Chicago Midway International Airport

runway.v: four runways; the longest is 13L-31R, 6,522 ft x 150 ft (about 1,988 m), for air carriers; 4R-22L 6,445 x 150 ft (air carrier); 4L-22R 5,507 x 150 ft and 13R-31L 3,859 x 60 ft (general aviation)

curfew.v: voluntary nighttime curfew for air carriers 00:00-06:00 local; the manual says nothing about business or charter flights at night
curfew.quote: A Voluntary Air Carrier Nighttime Curfew is in effect at Midway International Airport between the hours of 12:00 a.m.

noise.v: voluntary Fly Quiet Program: expedite climb through 1,500 ft MSL 22:00-06:00, night preferential runways; maintenance run-ups not allowed 22:00-07:00 weeknights and 22:00-09:00 weekends
noise.quote: The Fly Quiet Program is a voluntary program.

customs.v: CBP clears general aviation 7 days a week, 08:00-24:00 Central Time; permission to land must be requested before departure and at least 24 hours before arrival; landing permission valid +/-30 minutes; park at either FBO (Atlantic Aviation or Signature); Midway has no General Aviation Facility
customs.quote: Regular Office Hours 7 days per week, 0800-2400 Central Time (CT)

ppr.v: for international arrivals, CBP permission to land at least 24 hours before arrival
ppr.quote: at least 24 hours in advance of the anticipated arrival time at KMDW.

handling.v: two FBOs: Atlantic Aviation and Signature Flight Support

fuel.v: Atlantic Aviation supplies Jet A and avgas by fuel truck (tender); Menzies fuels airlines only; Signature lists no fuel (contingency plan, Jan 2024)
fuel.quote: Fuel: Jet A Tenders, Avgas Tender

deicing.v: Signature Flight Support lists aircraft de-icers (contingency plan, Jan 2024)
